meta.purpose: Component inventory backing audit/02-threat-model.md and audit/threat_register.json. Every threat-register 'component' value MUST be an id defined here.
meta.note: audit/01-architecture.md and audit/01-inventory.json (prior audit phase, added mid-generation) are the formal architecture baseline; this inventory is the component-id namespace that audit/threat_register.json references. Deployment facts (package/platform/registry ids) are sourced from 01-inventory.json.

components.name: account.move — soulbound identity + handle registry
components.role: SocialAccount (key, no store — non-transferable), Registry (handle↔address), assert_authenticates gate for all paying functions.

components.name: platform.move — fee schedule, pauses, treasury
components.role: Platform shared object + PlatformCap (key, store). Fee ceilings: 30% fee, 50% referral share of platform cut, 100 SUI creation fee. Ships creation-paused.

components.name: creator.move — creator vault, settle/split, Seal approval
components.role: CreatorVault<T> per coin type; compute_split (u128); subscribe/renew/tip/unlock; claim via CreatorCap; seal_approve_subscription ranks by price_paid; migrate_as_platform.

components.name: entitlement.move — soulbound Subscription/Unlock, Seal identities
components.role: Soulbound entitlement objects; identity layouts vault‖0x00‖key and vault‖0x01‖tier‖period; retired index-ranked seal_approve_subscription now aborts; covers_period judged at period start.

components.name: stake_vault.move — no-loss staking vault, rebate accumulator
components.role: StakeVault: deposits/withdrawals, FreshEntry maturity markers, acc_rebate_per_unit accumulator, permissionless harvest, assert_solvent invariant, migrate_as_platform.

components.name: stake_ladder.move — tranche ladder policy
components.role: LADDER_DEPTH=6, one rung per epoch (derived staked_this_epoch), is_matured (<=), rung_size, unwind_newest, MAX_TRANCHES=16.

components.name: key_registry.move — on-chain X25519 DM key registry
components.role: KeyRegistry shared table address→PublishedKey; publish/revoke; version high-water mark; validates length + non-zero only.

components.name: soul.move — agent employment record (Northlatch)
components.role: EmployeeSoul (shared, soulbound-by-sharing), MasterCap/LedgerCap, allowance metabolism, adoption (offer/adopt/renounce), tiers, settle_epoch gated on chain epoch.

components.name: agent_mind.move — Seal approval for agent minds
components.role: seal_approve_mind entry: mind identity = account-id‖0x02; binds encrypted mind to the SocialAccount object, not a key.

components.name: /api/agents/sponsor — sponsored registration
components.role: Sponsors gas for account::open (requires declare-agent signature) and creator::open_vault (no signature at request time); refuses caller-supplied transactions.

components.name: /api/agents/* — declarations, seeking, offers
components.role: declare (two signatures, 24h operator window), seeking (proveActionWithoutSpending), declare/pending, seeking/offers, public GETs.

components.name: /api/agents/mind — agent encrypted-mind storage
components.role: POST: signature-bound ciphertext hash, declared-agent check, quota, Walrus store. GET: unauthenticated ciphertext metadata + nonce/envelope.

components.name: /api/checkout/* — quote/prepare/submit, subscribe, tip, unlock
components.role: Server-built PTBs, simulate→quote (issued_quotes allowlist), submitSigned relay gated on unexpired quoted digest, Idempotency-Key on submit.

components.name: /api/media/[postId]/[assetId] — gated asset serving
components.role: Bind asset→post via DB, read-session reader, on-chain entitlement check (fail-closed on truncation), serves ciphertext+headers for seal-scheme, decrypted bytes for legacy platform-scheme.

components.name: /api/seal — public Seal settings descriptor
components.role: Returns network/package ids and key-server {objectId, weight, aggregatorUrl}. No secrets.

components.name: /api/studio/upload — media upload + sealing
components.role: upload signature over fileSha256; uploader must equal on-chain vault.owner; AES-GCM + Seal-wrap for gated posts; publisher-JWT Walrus PUT with blob object sent to creator.

components.name: /api/messages* — DMs (plaintext + E2E)
components.role: send/send-encrypted statements; signature over ciphertext digest; Idempotency-Key; thread listing.

components.name: /api/session — read-session minting
components.role: Single-use read-content signature mints 32-byte token (sha256-stored, 2h TTL), projectx_read cookie or Bearer.

components.name: /api/zklogin/* — zkLogin session/complete/export
components.role: Google ID-token verification (jose, JWKS, aud, nonce), HKDF salt from irrotatable seed, remote prover with x-projectx-prover-key.

components.name: /api/stake/* — stake vault reads and withdraw prep
components.role: Vault figures, suggested deposits, withdraw prepare/quote, rebate/settings writes.

components.name: /api/csp-report + /api/telemetry/error — error intake
components.role: Unauthenticated CSP reports and telemetry into error_events, capped field lengths.

components.name: lib/identity.ts — signature verification + single-use spend
components.role: verifyAction (prove→spend→sweep), verifyPersonalMessageSignature with client, 10-min window (+60s future skew), used_signatures INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, proveTransaction for money path.

components.name: lib/rate-limit.ts — limiters, quotas, breakers
components.role: In-process rateLimit Map; DB sharedLimit/simulateLimit (ip: keying behind Cloudflare/edge-secret); per-address quotaLimit (agent_quotas); deployment-wide tripBreaker keyed '*deployment*' with BREAKER_ENV.

components.name: lib/checkout.ts — PTB building, quotes, relay
components.role: Server-built transactions; MIST-denominated SUI paths; issued_quotes row consumed by digest on submit (30-min lifetime); simulate→quote step.

components.name: lib/sponsor.ts — sponsor key, seats, slots, shape asserts
components.role: PROJECTX_SOCIAL_SPONSOR_KEY env key; SPONSORSHIP_SEATS=50, SEAT_HOLD_MS=15min, per-address+per-handle rows; claimVaultSlot (50 slots, no expiry, no chain confirm); assertIsOnlyAccountOpen shape gate; simulate-then-sign; refuses non-zero creation fee.

components.name: lib/media.ts — asset store/read, encrypt, seal wrap
components.role: Magic-byte sniff; AES-GCM encryptBlob for gated posts; sealUnlockKey/sealPeriodKey wrap; publisher token mint; legacy platform-scheme server-side decrypt with enc_key from DB.

components.name: lib/seal.ts — server-side Seal wrapping
components.role: SealClient encrypt of blob keys at upload; verifyKeyServers: true; never decrypts seal-scheme.

components.name: lib/entitlement.ts — on-chain entitlement reads
components.role: Reads reader-owned Subscription/Unlock objects (BCS, ≤20 pages), canRead predicate, truncated flag surfaced.

components.name: lib/walrus.ts — Walrus client
components.role: Publisher PUT (https-only unless loopback, JWT bearer), aggregator GET reads, 16MB stream cap, alreadyCertified handling.

components.name: lib/read-session.ts — read sessions
components.role: 32-byte random tokens stored as sha256, 2h TTL, cookie or Bearer; revocation only by deleting all sessions for an address.

components.name: lib/zklogin-server.ts — zkLogin server logic
components.role: Google jwtVerify (RS256, aud, clockTolerance 0), nonce = generateNonce(ephemeral, maxEpoch, randomness), salt = HKDF(PROJECTX_SOCIAL_ZKLOGIN_SEED), prover call with shared key header.

components.name: lib/publisher-token.ts — Walrus publisher JWT
components.role: HS256 over {epochs, size, send_object_to}, 60s lifetime, random jti; secret PROJECTX_WALRUS_PUBLISHER_JWT_SECRET authorises spending the publisher wallet.

components.name: Postgres schema (44 migrations)
components.role: Tables incl. used_signatures, issued_quotes, agent_quotas, agent_requests (idempotency), agent_sponsorships, agent_sponsored_vaults, assets (blob_id + enc keys + seal wrapped key), posts, messages, encryption_keys (legacy), read_sessions, error_events. RLS enabled; REVOKE from anon/authenticated.

components.name: proxy.ts — waitlist gate
components.role: Waitlist-mode gate on pages (read session / admin / access-code); no API auth; sets x-weir-pathname.

components.name: next.config.ts — CSP and security headers
components.role: Enforced CSP (object-src, base-uri, form-action, frame-ancestors); hash-pinned Report-Only script-src to /api/csp-report; nosniff, X-Frame-Options DENY, x-projectx-commit.

components.name: sdk statements.ts — signed-statement grammar
components.role: statementFor head binds address/timestampMs/origin; 17 action kinds; SIGNATURE_WINDOW_MS=10min; OPERATOR_OFFER_WINDOW_MS=24h; isSingleUse=true for all kinds; long payloads bound by SHA-256.

components.name: sdk money.ts — decimal-exact amounts
components.role: parseAmount/formatAmount with per-coin decimals (0..38), refuses excess precision, string-based bigint units.

components.name: sdk client.ts — fullnode reads incl. CoinMetadata
components.role: Reads CoinMetadata.decimals per coin type; fails rather than guessing when metadata is unpublished.

components.name: sdk seal.ts — identity builders + approval PTBs
components.role: unlock/period identity bytes (mirrors Move), approveUnlock/approveSubscription transaction builders for client-side decrypt.

components.name: sdk e2e.ts — DM encryption
components.role: X25519 + xchacha20poly1305; private key derived client-side from wallet signature of KEY_STATEMENT; per-recipient ephemeral envelopes.

components.name: sdk keyregistry.ts — on-chain key reads
components.role: Reads KeyRegistry table dynamic fields by address (registry id from env PROJECTX_SOCIAL_KEY_REGISTRY_ID).

components.name: packages/signer policy-signer.ts — the signing gate
components.role: build/skip-build → gRPC simulate → SDK simulate gate → policy evaluate → audit append → sign. Fail-closed refuseUnexpected. signPersonalMessage allowed without effects evidence.

components.name: packages/signer adapters — local/multisig/kms/readonly
components.role: LocalKeypairSigner (env/keystore), multiSigSigner (m-of-n, verifies combined sig), kmsSigner (refusing stub), readOnlySigner (always refuses). birth-key tool refuses argv/env secrets, 0600, openssl-pinned.

components.name: direct-signing-paths.ts — enforced signing-site register
components.role: Exhaustive register of every non-browser signing site; held exact by test/the-only-path-claim.test.ts.

components.name: packages/policy rules.ts — 13 policy rules
components.role: sender-mismatch, command-kind, move-call-target allowlist, type-argument, transfer-recipient, object-input, gas-budget, balance-evidence, amount-wellformed, coin-type-unlisted, outflow-ceiling, approval-threshold.

components.name: packages/purse — heron-purse hot-key service
components.role: 1-of-2 multisig (hot+brake) agent purse; typed intents only ({intent}); pinned policy sha; hash-chained audit; serialized execution; key refused from argv/env; systemd LoadCredentialEncrypted.

components.name: packages/purse sweep/brake
components.role: Two-phase brake sweep: prepare (no key) → shape-inspect bytes → re-simulate → hidden terminal brake key → verify multisig member.

components.name: packages/agent — headless agent client
components.role: Ed25519 keypair (env PROJECTX_SOCIAL_AGENT_SECRET or external signer); signed statements byte-identical to server grammar; money via self-built Sui PTBs (unlock/subscribe/tip); ReadOnlyAgent variant without signing members.

components.name: packages/agent tx.ts — build/simulate/sign
components.role: BCS round-trip check, simulate, sign, verify signature over same bytes; spend guard: mandatory maxPrice, chain-read price, refusal (never clamp) on mismatch.

components.name: packages/mcp transport.ts — MCP surface control
components.role: Capability gating (spend/write tools only when signing+policy); HTTP mode forcibly keyless; Host/Origin allowlists; cookie refusal; policy doc validation; policySigner application.

components.name: packages/mcp tools.ts — 15 MCP tools
components.role: weir_search/quote/read/authorship/agents/seeking/balance/buy/subscribe/post/send/price/declare/offers/accept; weir_read never opens paid posts; untrusted-text wrapping; strict decimal ceilings.

components.name: agent-runtime check-rules.ts — beat sandbox rules
components.role: 10 startup-refusal rules: no self-rewrite, loopback gateway, MCP allowlist with sha256-pinned non-interpreter stdio, no channels, no cron/hooks, model-host allowlist, env allowlist.

components.name: packages/daemon engine — tick decisions
components.role: MAX_VAULTS_PER_TICK=200; decideHarvest from fresh chain state; truncated batches flagged; per-vault once per tick.

components.name: packages/daemon adapters/signer.ts — policy-signed harvest
components.role: Gas-only key PROJECTX_DAEMON_SIGNER_SECRET via policySigner; allowedTargets=[stake_vault::harvest]; allowedObjects=[vaultId, 0x5]; hash-chained audit anchored per run.

components.name: packages/daemon adapters/discovery.ts — vault discovery
components.role: Paginates StakeVaultOpened events (50/page, ≤maxDiscoveryPages default 20); no owner filter; truncated=true past cap.

components.name: packages/daemon journal — run ledger + lock
components.role: pg_try_advisory_lock single instance (per-DB); run rows + daemon_harvests with 'claims success must name the transaction' constraint; stuckRuns logged only; lastHarvestOf not consulted by engine.

components.name: packages/daemon supervisor + heartbeat
components.role: Exponential backoff with jitter; graceful shutdown 30s; heartbeat POST only after fully clean tick; send failures logged and ignored.

components.name: Sui fullnode / gRPC (read + simulate + relay)
components.role: Transaction building clients, simulation, digest submission. Trusted for reads; on-chain state is the authority.

components.name: Walrus aggregator (reads)
components.role: https://aggregator.walrus-mainnet.walrus.space default; serves blob ciphertext; integrity cross-checked by recorded sha256.

components.name: Walrus publisher (writes)
components.role: Spends publisher wallet SUI/WAL on blob storage; requests authenticated solely by HS256 JWT from PROJECTX_WALRUS_PUBLISHER_JWT_SECRET.

components.name: Seal key-server committee
components.role: PROJECTX_SOCIAL_SEAL_KEY_SERVERS (objectId|weight|url, https-only) + PROJECTX_SOCIAL_SEAL_THRESHOLD; execute seal_approve* as reader; release threshold shares.

components.name: Google OAuth (zkLogin issuer)
components.role: ID-token issuer; JWKS fetched by server; aud=clientId enforced.

components.name: zkLogin prover service
components.role: Remote prover reached with x-projectx-prover-key; produces zk proof for derived address.

components.name: Hosted Postgres (Supabase) instance
components.role: Pool max 3, statement_timeout 8000ms; availability of limiters/idempotency/single-use ledger fail closed (503) if unreachable.
